review_text: The esewa has a potential to bring up a huge change for our Nation. Since fonepay being the key power of e-SEWA, it could rise up as the only best e-payment gateway of our Nation. Make us proud as we people have been left out of making foreign payments. It has the ability to bring our currency value up and known to the world as well. Nevertheless, I suggest not to limit user ID up to the mobile number, but should be of combination of alphanumerics. E-tickets is the another bright part of this portal. ~ Bina
